SourceRef.description: A pointer to the datum that moved this view.
SourceRef.title: SourceRef

output_schema.description: A geopolitical threat assessment + leader recommendation for one party at one decision date.

symbol.description: Party code assigned to this cell (USA or CHN). Echo it back; you do not choose it.
symbol.title: Symbol

score.description: Set this EQUAL to your threat_score. It carries your threat reading into the record so it is not lost.
score.title: Score

threat_score.description: THREAT SCORE on [-1, +1]. Perceived threat to THIS party's interests from the current state of the dispute. -1 = clear opportunity; 0 = neutral/unclear; +1 = existential threat. Use the party-relative anchors in the brief above.
threat_score.title: Threat Score

action_score.description: ACTION SCORE on [-1, +1]. Your recommended stance on the escalate(-1) ↔ concede(+1) axis. -1 = maximal escalation; 0 = hold/negotiate; +1 = maximal concession. Use the anchors in the brief above.
action_score.title: Action Score

action_level.description: ACTION LEVEL: the action you recommend, from the static list in the brief above. Must be consistent with your action_score band. One of: escalate_tariffs, escalate_non_tariff, retaliate, negotiate, hold, partial_rollback, concede_purchases, full_rollback.
action_level.title: Action Level

rationale.description: Structured as: 'RECOMMENDATION: <what should we do now, 2-4 sentences>\n\nSUPPORTING RATIONALE: <why this threat_score and this action_score, grounded in cited evidence>'. The recommendation must align with the threat and action scores. The supporting rationale must cover both: what drives the threat reading and what justifies the action stance.
rationale.title: Rationale

output_schema.title: GeopolView
